STRICT SHEET LAYOUT: EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS, EXACTLY EIGHT ROWS, EXACTLY 32 COMPLETE FIGURES TOTAL. No fifth or sixth column, no additional guard poses. Each of the 32 numbered-by-order pose descriptions below corresponds to exactly one cell.

Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and broad rounded head and fully clothed heroic body. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: SPROTO #3215, the ONE GREEN/YELLOW superhero creature in reference image 1. Preserve its broad rounded head, long swept OLIVE/LIME GREEN spikes flaring far backward, YELLOW ear interiors, heavy BLUE oval upper eyelids, TWO sleepy solid YELLOW oval visible eye areas with NO BLACK PUPILS, green cheek/eye rim, very broad YELLOW muzzle/chin/neck and a wide curved RED closed smiling mouth. The reference eyes are sleepy yellow ovals under blue lids, never black cartoon pupils. No separate red clown nose. Keep the large cheerful round face and yellow lower jaw from the photo.
COSTUME MUST MATCH THE PHOTO: a broad opaque BLACK high shoulder mantle/yoke draped across the shoulders and upper chest, bright YELLOW fitted chest below it, RED long sleeves, and a RED double-lobed bow-like chest ornament with a small round green-and-silver medallion fixed at its center. This is heroic costume armor/fabric, NOT a business vest or casual jacket. Extend the cropped costume coherently as a fitted YELLOW superhero suit covering abdomen, hips and both legs, simple BLACK waist belt, RED gauntlets with connected fingers and RED knee-high hero boots. The black shoulder mantle flows into a knee-length BLACK superhero CAPE with a RED inner lining, attached behind both shoulders; black outer cape and red lining are readable in folds. All torso/hips/legs are fully clothed. No green bare body, no black ordinary trousers or sneakers, no white shoe soles, no letters/logos, no weapons, no extra jewelry. Same black/yellow/red hero outfit, cape and chest ornament in every pose. The thick RED smiling lips must form a very broad red crescent across the yellow lower face, roughly 65 percent of head width, just like the photo. NO TEETH or tiny thin red mouth.

Row 1: relaxed combat guard; subtle exhale guard; forward guarded step with near foot leading; weight passes over near planted foot.
Row 2: forward guarded step with far foot leading; weight passes over far planted foot; forward dash with low lean and both legs anatomically connected; jump anticipation with hips lowered and knees bent.
Row 3: rising jump with both low-rooted knees gathered; falling jump with legs extending for landing; low crouched landing with both soles grounded; light punch anticipation with shoulder and elbow coiling.
Row 4: fully extended straight punch toward the right; punch retracting to guard; uppercut low-body coil; clear rising uppercut with elbow then fist high, two legs retained.
Row 5: side kick chamber, near knee lifted from LOW hip, support foot planted; half-extended kick with knee opening; fully extended waist-height side kick, low hip, ankle and toes aligned; kick knee retracts before planting.
Row 6: low sweeping kick with one grounded bent support leg; sweep recovery returning over the low pelvis; airborne kick chamber with both legs originating at lower body; airborne kick full extension with coherent second leg folded.
Row 7: recoiling from a chest hit, head and torso remain joined; solid two-arm high guard; reaching forward to catch with clearly visible open hand; close grab hold with both arms bent toward an imagined opponent but NO opponent drawn.
Row 8: forward throw release with planted low legs and torso follow-through, no opponent; ranged power anticipation with hands close to chest; ranged power release with front hand extended, no projectile; broad triumphant Team Special impact stance with both arms and both legs visible. Costume continuity is mandatory: BLACK shoulder mantle/cape, YELLOW fitted body AND legs, RED sleeves/gauntlets/boots, central red ornament/round brooch. Cape stays attached, falls with gravity, flares on dash/jump/kicks, stays behind limbs and entirely within each cell. Keep original wide green face, blue eyelids, solid yellow eyes WITHOUT pupils and yellow chin. Crisp pixel shading, no white highlights on black clothing, no floating effects. Exactly one complete body, two connected arms and two legs. Broad thick red lip crescent below the yellow muzzle, closed mouth without teeth. Do not shrink the red lips to a tiny line.
